from manim import *
import numpy as np

# Use the provided TeachingScene base class without modification.
class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Color points on each side of the line differently.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)
        
        # Initial vertical line passing through the pivot
        windmill_line = Line(
            self.grid['A3'] + UP*0.3, 
            self.grid['F3'] + DOWN*0.3, 
            color=WHITE_CLR
        )
        
        self.add(all_points)
        self.play(Create(windmill_line))
        self.wait(2.0) # L010: absorption time

        # Pick a line splitting points into two equal sets.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE_CLR)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)
        
        blue_group = VGroup(blue_1, blue_2)
        red_group = VGroup(red_1, red_2)
        
        # Use SurroundingRectangles to group points visually

        rect_red = SurroundingRectangle(red_group, color=RED_CLR, buff=0.2)

        blue_count = Text("2", color=BLUE_CLR, font_size=24)
        red_count = Text("2", color=RED_CLR, font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(blue_count, 'A2')
        self.place_at_grid(red_count, 'A4')
        
        self.play(Create(rect_blue), Create(rect_red))
        self.play(Write(blue_count), Write(red_count))

        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)

        def line_updater(l):

            center = pivot_p.get_center()
            dir_vec = np.array([np.cos(current_angle), np.sin(current_angle), 0])
            l.set_points_by_ends(center - dir_vec * 3, center + dir_vec * 3)

        arrow_trade_2 = Arrow(self.grid['C3'], self.grid['C4'], color=RED_CLR, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow_trade_1), GrowArrow(arrow_trade_2))
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # Update point roles: old pivot becomes red, red_1 becomes new pivot
        self.play(
            pivot_p.animate.set_color(RED_CLR),
            red_1.animate.set_color(WHITE_CLR),
            FadeOut(arrow_trade_1), FadeOut(arrow_trade_2)
        )
        
        # Switch the line's pivot point to the new point red_1
        windmill_line.remove_updater(line_updater)
        
        def line_updater_new(l):
            current_angle = PI/2 - angle_tracker.get_value()
            center = red_1.get_center()
            dir_vec = np.array([np.cos(current_angle), np.sin(current_angle), 0])
            l.set_points_by_ends(center - dir_vec * 3, center + dir_vec * 3)
            
        windmill_line.add_updater(line_updater_new)
        
        # Continue slight rotation to show it's now pivoting around the new point
        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.increment_value(PI/8), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(1.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # The total count on each side remains perfectly balanced.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE_CLR)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW_CLR)
        
        # New groupings: Blue side (blue_1, blue_2), Red side (pivot_p, red_2)
        new_blue_group = VGroup(blue_1, blue_2)
        new_red_group = VGroup(pivot_p, red_2)
        
        rect_blue_final = SurroundingRectangle(new_blue_group, color=BLUE_CLR, buff=0.2)
        rect_red_final = SurroundingRectangle(new_red_group, color=RED_CLR, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(rect_blue_final), Create(rect_red_final))
        # Pulse counts to emphasize the invariant (L004)
        self.play(Indicate(blue_count), Indicate(red_count))
        self.wait(2.0)
